blueprint.title: The Safe Choice
blueprint.setting: A warm Saturday afternoon in spring, starting at home and moving to the community center.
blueprint.problem: Li Ming is anxious about joining the choir competition because he is afraid he will make mistakes in front of others and wants to ensure he isn't unprepared or embarrassed.
blueprint.incitingEvent: Li Ming's mother hands him the registration form for the school choir competition, urging him to join.

beats.what: Li Ming receives the invitation to join the choir but feels hesitant and worried.
beats.because: the story opens

beats.what: Mom sits down with Li Ming to discuss his worries. She helps him understand that the most important thing is safety in his preparation, not perfection.
beats.because: Li Ming expressed his hesitation in the bedroom, prompting Mom to intervene.

beats.what: They browse the music section to find simpler sheet music or reliable practice tips, realizing that picking the right material makes practice easier.
beats.because: To feel 'safe' and prepared as advised by Mom, they need better resources.

beats.what: Li Ming practices with the new material. He realizes that as long as he practices carefully, he doesn't need to be perfect, just consistent.
beats.because: Having selected the right material at the library, they return to practice.

beats.what: Li Ming goes to class and decides to talk to his teacher about his plan to join, feeling confident about his choice.
beats.because: The successful practice session gave him the confidence needed to commit.

blueprint.resolution: Li Ming decides to participate in the choir competition, no longer afraid because he has prepared carefully and chosen a manageable approach.

targetPlan.why: Li Ming needs to name the specific activity he is being asked to join. Without this verb, he cannot define the problem.
targetPlan.speaker: Narrator
targetPlan.intent: To state the event Li Ming is considering.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 妈妈希望李明参加合唱比赛。

targetPlan.why: Li Ming needs to acknowledge the physical receipt of the invitation/form, establishing the concrete trigger for his anxiety.
targetPlan.speaker: Narrator
targetPlan.intent: To show he received the document.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 李明得到了报名表。

targetPlan.why: Mom needs to verify that Li Ming truly grasps her advice about preparation, shifting from emotional fear to logical understanding.
targetPlan.speaker: 妈妈
targetPlan.intent: To check comprehension.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 你现在了解我的意思了吗？

targetPlan.why: Mom uses 'safe' metaphorically to describe a low-risk practice strategy, contrasting it with the 'danger' of being unprepared.
targetPlan.speaker: 妈妈
targetPlan.intent: To promise reduced risk of failure.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 这样的练习方法是安全的。

targetPlan.why: They are physically looking at options. They need a verb to describe the act of picking one specific book over others.
targetPlan.speaker: Narrator
targetPlan.intent: To describe the act of selection.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 李明选择了一本简单的书。

targetPlan.why: Li Ming is realizing the conditional nature of his success: effort leads to results. He needs a conjunction to express this sufficient condition.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.intent: To express a sufficient condition for success.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 只要我认真练习，就可以唱好。

targetPlan.why: Li Ming wants to emphasize his changed attitude to his teacher. He needs an adverb to intensify 'happy' or 'confident'.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.intent: To emphasize the degree of his emotion.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 我特别想参加这次比赛。

blueprint.title: Li Ming's School Competition Choice
blueprint.setting: Li Ming's bedroom and the school classroom, during an afternoon after school.
blueprint.problem: Li Ming needs to decide which school activity to join.
blueprint.incitingEvent: Xiao Hong tells Li Ming about two upcoming school activities.

beats.what: Xiao Hong calls Li Ming and tells him about two activities: a sports game and a drawing contest.
beats.because: the story opens with the introduction of the options

beats.what: Li Ming is confused because he likes both, but can only choose one.
beats.because: Xiao Hong just presented conflicting attractive options

beats.what: Li Ming asks Xiao Hong for details to help him understand the requirements.
beats.because: He cannot choose without more information

beats.what: Xiao Hong explains the sports game involves running, which has some safety risks, while drawing is safe.
beats.because: Li Ming asked for details on requirements/conditions

beats.what: Li Ming decides he wants to join the drawing contest because he is worried about getting hurt.
beats.because: He understood the safety difference

beats.what: Li Ming successfully signs up and gets his participation certificate/confirmation.
beats.because: He made a decision the night before

blueprint.resolution: Li Ming chooses the drawing contest for safety, successfully registers, and feels happy about his clear decision.

targetPlan.why: Xiao Hong needs to tell Li Ming that there are events to take part in.
targetPlan.speaker: 小红
targetPlan.refersTo: The sports game and drawing contest
targetPlan.intent: Inform Li Ming about the opportunity to join activities.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 学校有比赛，你想参加吗？

targetPlan.why: Li Ming states he has difficulty deciding between two likes.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.refersTo: The act of picking one activity over the other
targetPlan.intent: Express his dilemma.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 这两个我都喜欢，很难选择。

targetPlan.why: Li Ming needs to ask for more specific information to make a decision.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.intent: Request clarification.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 请你告诉我，我想了解更多。

targetPlan.why: Xiao Hong explains that running has risks, contrasting with the safe nature of drawing.
targetPlan.speaker: 小红
targetPlan.refersTo: The physical safety aspect of the sports event
targetPlan.intent: Highlight the risk factor.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 跑步有可能不安全，画画很安全。

targetPlan.why: Li Ming conditions his preference on the outcome of not getting hurt.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.intent: State his priority (safety over sports).
targetPlan.usageSketch: 只要我不受伤，我就很开心。

targetPlan.why: Li Ming confirms he received the physical proof of his registration.
targetPlan.speaker: Narrator (or Li Ming internal thought)
targetPlan.intent: Confirm successful completion of registration.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 李明得到了比赛的通知单。

blueprint.title: The Safe Club Choice
blueprint.setting: A Saturday afternoon in the city, moving from home to a school activity center.
blueprint.problem: Li Ming wants to join a new club but is worried about safety and cost, while Xiao Hong wants to join an expensive one.
blueprint.incitingEvent: Li Ming finds a flyer for a Hiking Club and shows it to Xiao Hong.

beats.what: Li Ming sees a notice about clubs and decides to look for information.
beats.because: the story opens

beats.what: Xiao Hong calls Li Ming and tells him about an expensive Photography Club she wants to join.
beats.because: Li Ming needed to know what clubs were available, so he asked his friend.

beats.what: Li Ming worries that the Photography Club is too expensive and might not be safe for beginners, so he wants to check the Hiking Club instead.
beats.because: Xiao Hong mentioned a very expensive club, making Li Ming consider cheaper and perhaps safer options.

beats.what: They walk to the center to talk to the teacher and compare the two clubs directly.
beats.because: Li Ming could not decide based on the phone call alone; he needed face-to-face facts.

beats.what: The teacher explains that the Hiking Club is free and has safety training, while the other club is risky without a teacher.
beats.because: They arrived at the center to ask the teacher for specific details about safety and cost.

beats.what: Li Ming chooses the Hiking Club because he finally obtained the correct information and feels secure.
beats.because: The teacher's explanation resolved the uncertainty about safety and cost.

blueprint.resolution: Li Ming joins the Hiking Club, realizing that getting accurate information (了解/得到) allows him to make a safe choice (选择/安全).

targetPlan.why: Li Ming needs to gather information before making a decision; he doesn't know the details yet.
targetPlan.speaker: Narrator describing Li Ming's thought
targetPlan.intent: To express the need for understanding/knowing more facts.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 李明想要了解更多关于俱乐部的信息。

targetPlan.why: Xiao Hong is talking about the act of joining/being part of a group activity.
targetPlan.speaker: Xiao Hong
targetPlan.intent: To state her intention to be a member of the club.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 我想参加那个摄影俱乐部。

targetPlan.why: Xiao Hong needs to emphasize that this specific club is notably different (expensive/nice).
targetPlan.speaker: Xiao Hong
targetPlan.refersTo: the price or quality of the club
targetPlan.intent: To highlight that this club is especially expensive or special.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 但是那个俱乐部特别贵。

targetPlan.why: Li Ming is evaluating risks. He needs the concept of 'safety' to compare the two options.
targetPlan.speaker: Li Ming
targetPlan.intent: To question if the activity is safe for a beginner.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 爬山安全吗？

targetPlan.why: They are asking the teacher for information pertaining to specific topics.
targetPlan.speaker: Li Ming
targetPlan.intent: To specify the topic of their inquiry to the teacher.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 老师，请问关于安全的情况怎么样？

targetPlan.why: The teacher explains a conditional rule: if you do X, then Y happens. This is a classic use case for 'only if/so long as'.
targetPlan.speaker: Teacher
targetPlan.intent: To explain that safety is guaranteed provided conditions are met.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 只要你听老师的话，就是安全的。

targetPlan.why: After gathering all info, Li Ming must make a final selection between the options.
targetPlan.speaker: Narrator
targetPlan.intent: To describe the final decision-making action.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 李明最后选择了爬山俱乐部。

targetPlan.why: Li Ming reflects that he has obtained the correct answer/information he sought at the beginning.
targetPlan.speaker: Narrator
targetPlan.intent: To show the result of his investigation: he got what he needed.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 他得到了正确的答案。

blueprint.title: The Homework Problem
blueprint.setting: Li Ming and Xiao Ming are classmates. It is a Saturday afternoon.
blueprint.problem: Li Ming cannot finish his homework because he has a question he does not understand.
blueprint.incitingEvent: Li Ming realizes he does not understand an important part of his homework.

beats.what: Li Ming is doing his homework but stops because he finds a difficult question.
beats.because: the story opens

beats.what: Li Ming calls Xiao Ming to ask for help with the homework.
beats.because: Li Ming needs help because he does not understand the question.

beats.what: Xiao Ming explains the answer, but Li Ming is confused because Xiao Ming is speaking fast.
beats.because: Li Ming called Xiao Ming to get help.

beats.what: They meet at Xiao Ming's house to discuss the homework face-to-face.
beats.because: The phone explanation failed, so they need to meet in person to clarify.

beats.what: Xiao Ming writes the answer on paper. Li Ming finally understands.
beats.because: Meeting in person allows Xiao Ming to show the answer visually.

beats.what: Li Ming finishes his homework and goes home happy. He chooses to study with friends next time.
beats.because: The problem is solved, so he reflects on the best method.

blueprint.resolution: Li Ming finishes his homework by meeting Xiao Ming. He decides that studying together is a safe and effective method.

targetPlan.why: Li Ming needs to admit that he lacks understanding of the homework question to explain why he stopped working.
targetPlan.speaker: Li Ming
targetPlan.intent: To express confusion and the need for help
targetPlan.usageSketch: 我不了解这个作业是什么意思。

targetPlan.why: Li Ming needs to specify the topic of his question when calling Xiao Ming.
targetPlan.speaker: Li Ming
targetPlan.intent: To clarify the subject of the phone call
targetPlan.usageSketch: 我想问你关于数学作业的问题。

targetPlan.why: Li Ming invites Xiao Ming to join his study effort, framing it as an activity they do together.
targetPlan.speaker: Li Ming
targetPlan.intent: To propose doing the homework together
targetPlan.usageSketch: 请你来参加我的学习活动吧。

targetPlan.why: Li Ming emphasizes the importance of the homework to motivate Xiao Ming to come over.
targetPlan.speaker: Li Ming
targetPlan.refersTo: The difficulty or importance of the homework
targetPlan.intent: To stress urgency or significance
targetPlan.usageSketch: 今天的作业特别难。

targetPlan.why: Li Ming expresses that he has now acquired the correct answer/information he was missing.
targetPlan.speaker: Li Ming
targetPlan.refersTo: The correct answer to the homework
targetPlan.intent: To confirm success in getting the solution
targetPlan.usageSketch: 我得到了正确的答案。

targetPlan.why: Li Ming confirms his new state of knowledge after seeing the written answer.
targetPlan.speaker: Li Ming
targetPlan.intent: To confirm understanding
targetPlan.usageSketch: 我现在完全了解这个问题了。

targetPlan.why: Xiao Ming explains the condition for solving the problem easily.
targetPlan.speaker: Xiao Ming
targetPlan.refersTo: The method of looking carefully/studying together
targetPlan.intent: To give a simple condition for success
targetPlan.usageSketch: 只要你仔细看，就能明白。

targetPlan.why: Li Ming makes a decision about his future study habits based on the positive experience.
targetPlan.speaker: Li Ming
targetPlan.refersTo: The method of studying with friends
targetPlan.intent: To state his new preference/decision
targetPlan.usageSketch: 我选择和朋友一起学习。

targetPlan.why: Li Ming describes the method of studying with a friend at a friend's house as 'safe' (reliable/secure), contrasting with being stuck alone.
targetPlan.speaker: Li Ming
targetPlan.intent: To describe the stability/reliability of the method
targetPlan.usageSketch: 这样学习很安全，我不担心做错了。
